━━━ Money · the panel, a basket partly on the shelf ━━━
(edits message 42)
💱 What the money of Korendal is worth

Your town's money «Talar» has a name but is not issued yet; until then the treasury and the shop work in SUP, the neutral city's money.

Nil is a unit of measure: one Nil counts as 100 SUP. It is only a rate to look at; no money is ever changed for Nil.

• 100 SUP is worth 1 Nil
• 1,000 SUP is worth 10 Nil
• 30 SUP is worth 0.3 Nil

🏦 Town treasury: 8,400 SUP (worth 84 Nil)

⚒ What the town's workplaces made in the last 7 game days: 960 SUP at reference prices (worth 9.6 Nil)

🧺 The common basket (what every town should be able to buy):
• Rice: 38 SUP at the shop, reference price 35 SUP
• Tea: not on the counter right now, reference price 45 SUP

📊 This basket costs 108.57% of the reference price here (the shop has 63.64% of it).

The town money's market, reserve and cover are not built yet and no made-up rate is given; once the town money is issued its market rate shows here.

The cheaper the basket, the more the town's money buys.
  ───
  [🔙 Back] → settlement:shop   │   [🔄 Refresh] → settlement:money
